L receive Bloodthirsty Flail

L Bloodthirsty Flails have Prepare (reduce Card by Count at End of Turn) 2
- Turn 2-3, cast (G)Helot: Catena's Exalt
L Play base Strike (to obtain 15% additional Crit Rate)
L Play held Flails
